privileged_info_for_vlm: The study OID is 'S_DM2024'. The ground truth mappings for the JSON are: Severity: 1='Grade 1 (Mild - No intervention)', 2='Grade 2 (Moderate - Local intervention)', 3='Grade 3 (Severe - Hospitalization)', 4='Grade 4 (Life-threatening)', 5='Grade 5 (Fatal)'. Relationship: 1='Not Related (Unlikely)', 2='Possibly Related', 3='Probably Related', 4='Definitely Related'. The agent must save these to /home/ga/ae_codelists.json.
